expected: list_capabilities as the narrow-profile agent-077 should be profile-filtered so only its narrow profile is offered, with catalog entries listed (not disabled); the corpus wording 'only logs.read visible' is documented in env.json.s077_narrow as an unreachable harness limitation, so S077 asserts profile filtering plus listed-not-disabled entries and records capability visibility as a limitation.
observed: As agent-077, list_capabilities returned profiles == ["narrow"] and default_profile == "narrow", proving per-agent profile filtering. Control agent-201 returned profiles == ["default"], default_profile == "default", confirming the filter is real and per-identity. All seven capabilities were listed as normal entries (dynamodb.query, lambda.invoke, logs.read, s3.read-prefix, s3.write-prefix, sqs.consume, sqs.produce) with params/summaries and no disabled flag, for both agents. Per-capability visibility narrowing to logs.read only is NOT enforced by the shipped catalog (no agents: list on any entry); env.json.s077_narrow documents this as a harness limitation, not a broker deviation. No MCP tool mutated any state.
evidence: mcp-call --token-file tokens/agent-077.token --tool list_capabilities --args '{}' --raw => profiles:["narrow"], default_profile:"narrow", capabilities: all 7 ids listed as normal entries (not disabled). Control: mcp-call --token-file tokens/agent-201.token --tool list_capabilities => profiles:["default"], default_profile:"default", caps: same 7 ids. Profile filtering differs per agent (narrow vs default) confirming enforcement; capability-visibility half recorded as documented harness limitation per env.json.s077_narrow.
